title: Cost Visibility: Cost Explorer, Budgets & Tags
summary: See, allocate and alert on spend with Cost Explorer, Budgets, CUR/Data Exports and cost allocation tags.
tldr: **See** spend: Cost Explorer (charts, grouping, forecasts). **Allocate** spend: activate **cost allocation tags** in the management account and enforce them with **tag policies**. **Analyze line items with SQL**: **AWS Data Exports** (CUR 2.0) to S3, queried with Athena.

**Alert and act**: AWS Budgets for fixed or forecast thresholds, with **budget actions** that apply an IAM policy or SCP or stop EC2/RDS instances. **Cost Anomaly Detection** uses ML, needs no thresholds and reports likely root cause.
**Consolidated billing** in AWS Organizations pools usage for volume tiers and shares Reserved Instance and Savings Plans discounts across member accounts.

keyFacts.text: User-defined tags appear in Cost Explorer, Budgets and CUR only after you activate them as cost allocation tags in the management (payer) account. Allow up to 24 hours.
When a threshold is hit, Budgets can attach an IAM policy, attach an SCP, or stop specific EC2 or RDS instances, automatically or after approval.
Data Exports delivers hourly line items with resource IDs and tags to S3 in Parquet. It is the source for SQL with Athena or joins with business data.
Cost Anomaly Detection monitors accounts, services, cost categories or tags, learns normal patterns, and alerts through email or SNS.

traps: Tagging resources isn't enough; until the tag is activated as a cost allocation tag it won't appear in billing tools.
Cost allocation tags are activated in the management account, not separately in each member account.

Budgets alerts only notify unless you configure a **budget action**; an alert alone never stops spending. From the management account, actions can apply an SCP to another account but can't stop its instances.
Savings Plans can't be shared with AWS RAM or resold on the RI Marketplace; sharing comes from consolidated billing.
CloudTrail and S3 Storage Class Analysis don't produce cost reports by tag.
